screen: Leave-one-county-out transport of log1p provided POI effective primary-category count; label-free unregistered diagnostic

method.outcome: log1p of the frozen effective primary-category count computed from provided Overture primary-category counts; only rows where that count is defined are eligible.
predictors: log1p provided unique assigned POI count
method.model: For each county, fit pooled OLS with intercept, official-region intercept indicators, and globally standardized predictors on all other complete-case counties. Standardization means and population SDs are fit on training counties only; zero-SD predictors use scale 1.
method.baseline: For each held county, predict the arithmetic mean of log1p effective count over all complete-case tracts in the other training counties; this mean is fitted without the held county.
method.county_fold: County FIPS is the first five characters of each exact 11-digit official tract GEOID. Each county is held out once; no county-level target or feature statistics enter its model fit.
method.score: County R2 = 1 - held-county model SSE / held-county training-mean baseline SSE. Pooled R2 uses the sums of held-county model SSE and fold-specific training-mean baseline SSE across all complete-case held-out tracts.
method.support: One frozen complete-case mask: effective count, log1p unique place count, pct_urban, Mx4 F, and S1 lag all finite. No imputation, post-result exclusions, or alternative support.
method.interpretation_limit: Provided-feature transportability diagnostic only; not hidden-target accuracy, causal evidence, or estimator-promotion evidence.

interpretation: County-held-out transport met its preregistered pooled-R2, positive-county-share, and support gates; this remains a provided-feature transportability diagnostic only.
